title: oligoneuron riddellii
intro: Oligoneuron riddellii, commonly known as Riddell's ironweed, is a flowering plant species belonging to the aster family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to the reduction of pain, fever, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Riddell's ironweed are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Research suggests that these constituents may have wound-healing, anti-cancer, and cardiovascular-protective effects.
